title: Data Architect III
description:
**Job Description**
 Data Architect III develops and leads enterprise data strategies and governance initiatives, architects and tests new database systems, and oversees complex data integration projects, ensuring adherence to data standards and strategic alignment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develops enterprise and platform\-specific data strategies in alignment with platform blueprints by analyzing business requirements and proposing data solutions
* Advances data governance initiatives and ensures compliance with data standards by coordinating with governance committees and implementing best practices
* Architects and tests prototypes for new database management systems and related tools by designing, coding, and conducting performance tests
* Champions the adoption of new database management system functionality and tools within the team by organizing workshops and providing hands\-on support
* Oversees metadata management and supports the creation of logical data architecture for technology platforms by defining metadata standards and ensuring their implementation
* Ensures data architecture meets enterprise data governance standards by participating in design reviews and providing strategic recommendations
* Selects and integrates data management tools and technologies by conducting market research and presenting findings to stakeholders
* Conducts complex data integration projects by coordinating with different teams, ensuring timely delivery, and maintaining data integrity throughout the process
* Collaborates and co\-creates effectively with teams in product and the business to align technology initiatives with business objectives


**Qualifications**
 Education Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, and/or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred
* Knowledge of developing data architecture for applications utilizing various database management systems (e.g., IMS, DB2 zOS, Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Netezza, Hadoop, MapR)
* Knowledge of both online transaction processing and online analytical processing systems
* Knowledge of data modeling tools (e.g., ErStudio, ErWin)
* Knowledge of distributed (multi\-tiered) systems and algorithms
* Knowledge of NOSQL design and flexible schema definitions with a variety of products (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase)
* Knowledge of infrastructure technologies and components (e.g., servers, Java virtual machines, networking concepts)


**Work Experience**
* Experience in data architecture, data modeling, database development, and/or comparable experience
* Experience in data integration tools and extract, transform, and load processes (e.g., extract, transform, and load tools like Informatica, Talend, or SSIS)
* Experience in database technologies such as SQL, NoSQL, and data warehousing solutions
* Experience in data security protocols and compliance standards
* Experience in documenting data processes and workflows
* Experience in data modeling and database design principles
* Experience in metadata management and database management concepts


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
   

  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial\-well\-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on\-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities


 American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
   

  

 Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: SAP S/4HANA Consultant – Cloud
description:
Crossing Hurdles is a global recruitment firm partnering with leading organisations to hire top talent across industries. We are currently hiring for a SAP Cloud Transformation Consultant Architect role on behalf of our client.
 



  





**Quick overview** 




**Position:** 
 SAP Cloud Transformation Consultant Architect
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Compensation:** 
 As per Industry Standards / Based on Experience
 



**Required Experience:** 
 8 10\+ Years in SAP consulting with a strong focus on S/4HANA Public Cloud.
 



**Working Days:** 
 Hybrid WFH (Selected candidates will need to travel to Jaipur for a 2 3 week onsite assessment)
 



**Location:** 
 Any Location in India
 



  





**Role Responsibilities** 



* Perform deep\-dive assessments of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud processes, controls, configurations, and integrations.
* Analyze current\-state implementation maturity against business processes and stakeholder expectations.
* Identify functional, technical, process, reporting, and master data gaps.
* Review workflows, interfaces, automation opportunities, and reporting challenges.
* Define stabilization, recovery, and implementation completion roadmaps.
* Recommend process optimization, control improvements, and remediation plans.
* Validate SAP FICO \& MM configurations, integrations, and reporting structures.
* Support remediation of master data quality and structural issues.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, and implementation partners.
* Drive implementation stabilization, business adoption, and Go\-Live re\-adoption support.
* Provide functional guidance, user support, training, and hypercare assistance.
* Assist in defining the future\-state operating model, transformation roadmap, and required skillsets.



  





**Requirements** 



* 8 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP consulting with a strong focus on S/4HANA Public Cloud.
* Deep expertise in SAP FICO and MM modules configuration, integration, and reporting.
* Proven experience in SAP implementation assessments, gap analysis, and stabilization projects.
* Strong understanding of business process design, master data management, and workflow automation.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams including business stakeholders and implementation partners.
* Ability to define and execute transformation roadmaps and future\-state operating models.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Prior experience in Go\-Live support, hypercare, and business adoption programs is a plus.
* Willingness to travel to Jaipur for a 2 3 week onsite assessment when required.



  





**Application Process** 



* Fill out the Google Form shared by us.
* Prescreening conducted by our team.
* Shortlisted profiles reviewed by the client; approved candidates are contacted for interviews and the next stages.
* 3\-4 interview rounds (a mix of technical and managerial).
* Final discussion and offer.

title: Windows System Administrator
description:
About the Role
 



 We are looking for a skilled Wintel Administrator (L2\) with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience to manage and support our data center infrastructure, which includes a virtualized VMware environment, physical servers, database servers, and network/security appliances across LAN and DMZ zones. The ideal candidate will handle day\-to\-day server administration, virtualization management, backups, monitoring, and L2\-level troubleshooting, while working closely with the infrastructure team on ongoing projects.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Manage and maintain Active Directory, File Server, Web Server (IIS, Apache, Nginx), and Application Servers
 



 • Administer and support VMware ESXi hosts and vCenter (multi\-host, multi\-cluster environment) — VM provisioning, migration, snapshots, and resource allocation
 



 • Manage physical server hardware (Dell PowerEdge, HP ProLiant) including out\-of\-band management via iDRAC
 



 • Install, configure, troubleshoot, and back up database servers — MS\-SQL, MySQL, MongoDB
 



 • Manage server backups and vReplication for disaster recovery of critical VMs and databases
 



 • Support and maintain monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix) to track server/host performance, uptime, and alerts
 



 • Install and configure new Windows, Linux, and desktop systems
 



 • Install and troubleshoot Windows/Linux applications and software (VB, C\#, .NET, Node.js\-based apps, etc.)
 



 • Support DMZ and LAN zone server management, coordinating with network/security team on firewall, load balancer, and VPN (Site\-to\-Site) configurations
 



 • Assist with basic public cloud tasks (AWS) where hybrid/DR connectivity is involved
 



 • Manage and troubleshoot LAN/DMZ switches, WAN links, and connectivity issues at a basic level
 



 • Assist with patch management, deployment, and server/firmware upgrades
 



 • Monitor and maintain server performance, availability, and health across physical and virtual infrastructure
 



 • Respond to and resolve end\-user issues escalated from Desktop Support (L1\)
 



 • Maintain accurate documentation of server inventory, IP allocations, configurations, and network diagrams
 



 • Work on ongoing IT infrastructure projects as assigned
 



 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



 • B.Tech or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field
 



 • Minimum 2–3 years of hands\-on experience as a Windows/Wintel Administrator
 



 • Strong working knowledge of Windows Server administration (2012/2016/2019/2022\)
 



 • Hands\-on experience with VMware ESXi and vCenter administration (multi\-vCenter environment preferred)
 



 • Experience with physical server hardware management — Dell PowerEdge / HP ProLiant, iDRAC/ILO remote management
 



 • Hands\-on experience with IIS, Apache, or Nginx web server management
 



 • Experience with MySQL, MS\-SQL, and MongoDB — installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and backup
 



 • Good understanding of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy
 



 • Working knowledge of firewall, load balancer, and basic network/VPN concepts (Site\-to\-Site VPN, WAN, DMZ)
 



 • Experience with server/VM backup and replication solutions for disaster recovery
 



 • Exposure to monitoring tools such as Zabbix or similar
 



 • Basic exposure to cloud platforms (AWS) for hybrid/DR connectivity
 



 • Familiarity with installing and troubleshooting applications like VB, C\#, .NET
 



 • Ability to troubleshoot server hardware, OS\-level (Windows/Linux), and virtualization issues
 



 • Experience with patch management and firmware/server upgrade cycles
 



 Soft Skills
 



 • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
 



 • Good communication skills to coordinate with end users, network team, and cross\-functional teams
 



 • Ability to work independently as well as escalate/collaborate with L3 when required
 



 • Willingness to work on\-call/rotational shifts if required
 



 • Detail\-oriented with a proactive approach to server monitoring, backups, and uptime management

title: NetSuite Suite Projects Pro System Administrator
description:
**About CPI**
 CPI is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change.
   

  

 With a team of experts across seven international offices, including a strong presence in emerging markets and developing economies, CPI is a leader in tracking sustainable investment trends, identifying innovative business models, and supporting the solutions that can drive the transition to a low\-carbon, climate\-resilient, inclusive economy. We are unique in our focus on finance, our ability to get the right people to the table, and our analytical rigor.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro System Administrator will be responsible for maintaining and managing CPI’s NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro environment, ensuring that project and resource data remain accurate, up\-to\-date, and compliant with organizational standards. This role will provide day\-to\-day system support, manage user access and configuration, and work closely with Operations, Finance, and IT teams to ensure smooth system adoption across the organization.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is highly detail\-oriented, enjoys working with data and systems, and has a strong service mindset to support staff queries and drive efficient system usage.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage and maintain the NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro (Formerly Net Suite OpenAir) system, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
* Configure, test, and update system settings, workflows, and permissions as required.
* Provide first\-line user support, resolving issues and queries in collaboration with the Operations and IT teams.
* Monitor and maintain project, resource, and timesheet data, ensuring consistency across departments.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics to support operational decision\-making.
* Coordinate with the vendor (Xero/Oracle NetSuite/OpenAir) for upgrades, enhancements, and troubleshooting.
* Managing large data imports and updates manually and via integration manager.
* Manage a SuiteProjects pro system where financial data is not held in NetSuite and integrates with CPI’s
* Conduct user training and onboarding sessions, ensuring consistent use of the platform.
* Create and maintain management processes in the system including data checking and validation.
* Create and maintain system documentation, SOPs, and data dictionaries.
* Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency and user experience.


 About You: Competencies and Experience
   

  

* Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science/IT systems Management and/or Business Administration, Engineering, and/or relevant certifications or professional experience.
* Overall, 6 years of relevant experience in system administration or operations roles with ERP, PSA, or project management tools such as NetSuite Suite Projects Pro, NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle.
* Demonstrated experience in data management, reporting, and workflow configuration.
* Strong Excel skills particularly for data transformation, cleaning and validation, including formulas, text formulas, XLookup and pivot tables.
* Experience working in small set up and managing projects independently with limited supervision.
* Experience working in multi\-country or global organizations preferred.
* Experience creating documentation, and training users in IT Systems and processes.
* Familiarity with reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) is a plus.


 About You: Personal Attributes
   

  

* Confidence to engage with a wide range of stakeholders and explain technical concepts to non\-technical users.
* Excellent organizational skills and a proactive, organized, and innovative approach to problem solving.
* Customer\-service orientation with the ability to manage queries efficiently.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within timelines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: Technical Lead & Sr Developers Web And Blockchain Applications
description:

 .

**Soft Skills**

**Why Join Bitfia?** 



* Work on

 .
* Build products involving

 .
* Work directly with founders and a highly entrepreneurial team.

 Experience: 4–8 Years

title: Cloud Migration Engineer
description:

 Cloud Migration Engineer

 NA

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry\-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next\-generation, AI\-powered applications.
   

  

 MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem \- database server, drivers, cloud, and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork, and a great sense of humor to help our customers be successful with MongoDB.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The position will be based in our Gurugram office. The standard work week will be Sunday to Thursday, every week.
   

  

 Cool things you’ll do
   

  

 You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges \- resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs \- interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
   

  

 What you need
   

  

 You should have 5\+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self\-taught, insatiably curious, and multi\-faceted.
   

  

 The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas
   

  

* Systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Understand core Kubernetes concepts, including containers, namespaces, custom resources and multi\-cluster deployments
* Should have a good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
* Storage engineering experience, including NAS, SAN, SSD, multi\-pathing, and caching
* Experience building and maintaining complex mission\-critical production database systems
* Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
* Experience analyzing issues holistically, from the application tier through the database, down to the storage
* Be able to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C\+\+, C\#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc.
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills


 If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large\-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud\-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
   

  

 You should possess a genuine desire to help people, the ability to think on your feet and remain calm under pressure while solving problems in real\-time. There’s a lot to learn, so the desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills is paramount. We work in a collaborative team environment, so a willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and good judgment to know when to seek help, is essential. We also aim to have diverse technical backgrounds and therefore different subject matter expertise is welcome.
   

  

*You do not need to have prior experience with MongoDB. We can teach you that!*
 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
* Experience with authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, AD
* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
* Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
* Experience with virtualization, Docker, Kubernetes (including CLI), ability to inspect resource / container status using relevant utilities and commands


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training.
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam.
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within MongoDB and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently.


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

 What you’ll be DOING
   

  

 What will your essential responsibilities include?
   

  

 End\-to\-end BAU (Run) responsibility for the GRM risk tooling ecosystem leveraging Microsoft Azure / Databricks, including:
   

  

* Natural Event Platform application landscape (run \+ operational support)
* STEC application landscape (run \+ operational support)


 This role includes involvement in some punctual projects needing good Databricks skills.
   

  

 You will report to be defined – GRM Tech Owner / Run Manager).

 We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
   

  

**Required Skills And Abilities**
- BAU / Run operations ownership (core mission)

- Own the day\-to\-day operational support for GRM GDP\-connected applications (Natural Event Platform apps, STEC apps).

- Run incident management (triage, root cause analysis, resolution, post\-mortems), including coordination with platform/provider teams where needed.

- Manage problem management: recurring issues elimination, reliability improvements, backlog prioritization for operational fixes.

- Ensure operational readiness for releases: runbooks, monitoring, alerting, rollback procedures, support model/TOM alignment.

- Implement and maintain monitoring \& observability (job health, pipeline success rates, latency, data quality checks, logs).

- Maintain/operate data quality controls relevant to the application ecosystem

- Project support (punctual contribution)

- Provide hands\-on engineering support to project initiatives when needed (capacity\-based), including:

* Notus modernization / recoding / migration activities (e.g., the confirmed move from Azure Batch to Databricks in GDP; PoC/benchmark contributions; industrialization work).

* Stakeholder management \& governance rhythm
* Act as the operational focal point for GRM and platform stakeholders, participating in governance/rituals (initiative reviews, risk follow\-ups) as required.
* Provide clear communication on incidents, risks, dependencies, and operational improvements.


**Specialist Skills \& Experience (must\-have)**
 Databricks \& Data Engineering
   

  

* good hands\-on expertise with Databricks in production contexts (workflows/jobs scheduling, cluster policies, libraries, notebooks, troubleshooting).
* Advanced PySpark and SQL skills for investigation and remediation of data and pipeline issues.
* Experience with production support for data platforms/app ecosystems (L2/L3\).


 Run/Service Management
   

  

* Proven experience operating services under SLA/OLA constraints: incident/problem/change management, runbooks, operational reporting.


 Cost / Performance / Reliability
   

  

* Demonstrated ability to manage compute cost, performance tuning, and reliability improvements—particularly relevant for scalable run workloads


**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Exposure to risk modeling / catastrophe modeling application contexts (helpful but not required).


 Key interfaces (who the role works with)
   

  

* GRM Tech \& Product stakeholders (application owners, BAU owners, governance leads) across Natural Event Platform, STEC apps
* AXA GO, mainly GDP \& CFGP teams (engineering) but as well transversal GO families such as security, access management, architecture supporting the platform releases and readiness.

 Success measures (KPIs / outcomes)
   

  

* High service stability: reduced incident volume, improved MTTR, fewer recurring problems.
* Operational readiness: complete runbooks, monitoring coverage, predictable release transitions.
* Cost and performance control: measurable improvements in compute cost monitoring and optimization (especially on Notus run consumption).
* Stakeholder satisfaction (derived from the three criteria above): clear communication, reliable support, proactive risk management.

* Coverage aligned to GRM needs.

description:
**Senior Technology Lead – Product, Platform \& Infrastructure** 




**Experience:** 
 5–9 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram / Delhi NCR
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Company:** 
 KonProzTech Private Limited
 



**Compensation:** 
 Competitive fixed compensation \+ performance\-linked growth. ESOP participation will be considered after completion of 1 year, based on performance, ownership and contribution.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





**KonProzTech Private Limited is the parent company that is building various products in the domain of tax, finance, consulting and compliance areas.** 




**VIDUR is our 1st flagship product that is today live in 170\+ cities with 11,000\+ users growing with 30% MoM.** 




**We recently also launched VMUS, AI native consulting tech platform for boutique consulting for India Inc., MSME and startups.** 




**KonProz has built enterprise grade AI Agents for clients like Nirmal Bang, NexEdge capital in the domain of Insurance and Wealth sector.** 




**We are looking for a Senior Technology Lead who can take end\-to\-end ownership of our technology — products, infrastructure, engineering team, scalability, security and technical decision\-making.** 




**This is not a role where you will only manage developers or attend sprint meetings.** 




**We need someone who can look at the complete technology ecosystem, understand what can go wrong before it goes wrong, step into difficult situations when required and make sure the technology team keeps moving.** 




**You will work closely with the founders and will gradually become the key technology owner across VIDUR’s products and enterprise solutions.** 




  





**What You Will Own Product \& Technology** 



* Take overall technology ownership across VIDUR’s web, mobile, AI and enterprise products.
* Understand the architecture and dependencies across existing products.
* Work closely with product, business and founders to convert business requirements into practical technology execution.
* Review architecture and make decisions around scalability, reliability and performance.
* Evaluate new technologies, AI models, tools and infrastructure where they can improve the product.







**Infrastructure \& Reliability** 



* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment architecture, databases, APIs, monitoring and system reliability.
* Identify infrastructure risks before they turn into production issues.
* Build proper monitoring, alerts, backups, redundancy and recovery processes.
* Handle critical production issues and exception scenarios with the team.
* Improve system performance, scalability and infrastructure costs as the business grows.
* **Engineering Team**
* **Understand the technical capability required for each product and build the right engineering team accordingly.**
* **Allocate developers and technical resources based on product priorities.**
* **Conduct technical interviews and help us hire strong engineers.**
* **Mentor developers and improve engineering standards across the team.**
* **Identify capability gaps, performance issues and dependency risks early.**
* **Build a culture where engineers take ownership instead of waiting for instructions.**
* **Engineering Processes**
* **Establish strong standards around code quality, code reviews, documentation, testing and releases.**
* **Ensure that products are being built with long\-term maintainability in mind.**
* **Create clear development, deployment and incident\-management processes.**
* **Maintain visibility over technical debt and make sure critical issues do not keep getting postponed.**
* **Challenge technical decisions when there is a better or more scalable approach. Risk \& Problem Solving**
* **A major part of this role is seeing problems early. We expect you to:**
* **Identify technology red flags before they become business problems.**
* **Think through failure and exception scenarios while building products.**
* Ask “what happens if this fails?” before something goes live.
* Take ownership during production incidents instead of passing responsibility between teams.
* Understand root causes rather than applying temporary fixes.
* Balance speed of execution with stability and long\-term architecture.
* **Enterprise \& Leadership Exposure**
* **As VIDUR grows, you will also represent the technology function externally. You should be comfortable:**
* **Joining technical discussions with enterprise clients.**
* **Understanding enterprise requirements around integrations, APIs, security, infrastructure and**
* **data.**
* **Explaining our technology architecture in simple business language.**
* **Participating in technology discussions with investors and potential strategic partners.**
* **Responding confidently to technical due\-diligence questions.**
* **Working with founders on technology roadmap, product roadmap and future team requirements.**
* **You do not need to be a salesperson, but you should be able to represent the technology behind VIDUR confidently.**
* **What We Are Looking For**
* **We are looking for someone with 5–9 years of strong technology experience, preferably involving SaaS, AI products, fintech, tax\-tech, consulting\-tech enterprise software or high\-scale B2B platforms.**



  





**You should have:** 



* **Strong understanding of modern web application architecture.**
* **Good understanding of backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.**
* **Experience working with AWS / Azure / GCP or similar cloud environments.**
* **Understanding of system scalability, security, monitoring and reliability.**
* **Experience managing or mentoring developers.**
* **Ability to review architecture and code even if you are not coding every feature yourself.**
* **Experience handling production systems and real\-world failures.**
* Ability to conduct technical interviews and evaluate engineering talent (How has lifecycle
* changed from SDLC to ADLC).
* Strong communication skills for discussions with founders, investors and enterprise clients.
* Experience working with AI/LLMs, RAG, vector databases, document processing or AI\-native products would be a strong advantage.
* More Important Than the Tech Stack
* We care significantly about how you think. We want someone who:
* Thinks like an owner aka family;
* Takes responsibility when something breaks.
* Challenges assumptions instead of blindly executing requirements.
* Can operate with ambiguity.
* Is comfortable making decisions.
* Flags risks early, even when nobody has asked about them.
* Can go deep into a technical issue when required.
* Understands both technology and its business impact.
* Is willing to take on difficult problems.
* Can build systems and teams, not just features.
* If your first question when something goes wrong is “Who is responsible for this?”, this may not be the right role.
* If your first question is “What happened, how do we fix it, and how do we ensure it does not happen again?”, we would like to speak with you.
* What Success Looks Like
* Within the first year, we would expect you to:
* Have a strong understanding of the complete VIDUR technology architecture.
* Reduce critical production and infrastructure risks.
* Create better visibility over system performance and reliability.
* Build stronger engineering processes.
* Identify and close important skill gaps within the technology team.
* Improve the quality and speed of product releases.
* Create a scalable technical roadmap for future VIDUR products.
* Become the go\-to technology person for founders, enterprise clients and the engineering team.



  





**Why Join VIDUR** 



* **This role gives you the opportunity to take genuine technology ownership without being restricted to one engineering function.**
* **You will work directly with the founders, influence product and architecture decisions, participate in enterprise and investor discussions, build the engineering organization and help shape the next phase of VIDUR.**
* **For someone who demonstrates strong ownership and long\-term commitment, ESOP participation may be explored after completion of 1 year.**
* **This is a role for someone who wants to build — not just manage.**

title: Manager – ERP Implementation/Transformation Readiness, PI - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
   

  

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance


**How You Will Contribute**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation. The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Expertise across one or more of the following areas
   

  

* FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment
* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current\-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
* Finance Process Readiness
* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period\-end and year\-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet\-driven, highly customized, or non\-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future\-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
* Finance Master Data \& Chart of Accounts Readiness
* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data. Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master\-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
* Functional Readiness
* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori\-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean\-core readiness assessments.
* Data Migration Readiness
* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open\-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
* Integration \& Technology Readiness
* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with: MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
* Reporting \& Management Information Readiness
* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
* Controls \& Compliance Readiness
* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation\-of\-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future\-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
* Stakeholder \& Program Leadership
* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross\-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
* Team Leadership
* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.


**Qualifications**
* 6–11 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Finance processes and their ERP enablement.
* Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts, financial master data, organizational structures, reporting, controls, and data migration.
* Experience working with Finance leadership and senior business stakeholders.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and complex transformation workstreams.
* Strong consulting, problem\-solving, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Lead Engineer - Data & AI Platform

**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator
description:
**🌟 We're Hiring: Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator! 🌟** 




 We are looking for a skilled and proactive Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator with at least 5 years of experience to join our team. If you are passionate about database management, optimization, and security, this is your chance to make an impact in a dynamic environment.
 



**📍 Location:** 
 Gurugram, India
   

**⏰ Work Mode:** 
 Work from anywhere
   

**💼 Role:** 
 Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator
 



**What You'll Do:** 




****SQL Development \& Database Design****



* **Develop and maintain complex
 **T\-SQL queries, Stored Procedures, Views, Functions, and database objects** 
 .**
* **Design and modify tables, indexes, constraints, and other database objects.**
* **Write efficient and maintainable SQL for large\-volume transactional systems.**
* **Understand SQL Server query processing and
 **logical execution order of SQL statements** 
 .**
* **Use CTEs, subqueries, window functions, APPLY, temporary tables, table variables, and other appropriate SQL techniques.**
* **Review existing SQL code and identify opportunities for performance and maintainability improvements.**
* **Work closely with developers to improve application/database interaction and scalability.**



****SQL Performance Tuning****



* **Analyse and optimize slow\-running queries and Stored Procedures.**
* **Analyse
 **execution plans** 
 and identify scans, lookups, joins, spills, excessive memory grants, and other performance issues.**
* **Perform index analysis and recommend appropriate indexes.**
* **Troubleshoot
 **blocking, deadlocks, waits, CPU, memory, and I/O\-related issues** 
 .**
* **Analyse SQL Server wait statistics, including waits such as PAGEIOLATCH, CXPACKET, CXSYNC\_PORT, ASYNC\_NETWORK\_IO, etc.**
* **Use
 **Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events, and SQL Server monitoring tools** 
 for performance investigation.**
* **Identify whether performance issues originate from SQL, database design, application behaviour, or infrastructure.**



****SQL Server Administration****



* **Manage SQL Server databases in staging and production environments.**
* **Manage database users, logins, roles, permissions, and security.**
* **Configure and troubleshoot
 **SQL Server Agent Jobs** 
 .**
* **Configure and troubleshoot
 **Linked Servers** 
 .**
* **Manage database\-level configuration and troubleshoot SQL Server configuration issues.**
* **Perform database backup, restore, migration, and recovery activities when required.**
* **Monitor database health, storage, capacity, and performance.**
* **Manage indexes and statistics where appropriate.**
* **Troubleshoot production database incidents and participate in RCA activities.**



****AWS RDS for SQL Server****



* **Strong practical experience with
 **AWS RDS for SQL Server** 
 .**
* **Understand RDS architecture, supported features, and limitations compared with traditional SQL Server.**
* **Work with:**
	+ **RDS Parameter Groups**
	+ **Option Groups**
	+ **Snapshots**
	+ **CloudWatch**
	+ **Performance Insights**
	+ **Storage and IOPS**
	+ **Instance sizing**
* **Monitor and troubleshoot database performance using AWS and SQL Server monitoring tools.**
* **Understand how SQL Server workloads behave within a managed RDS environment.**
* **Troubleshoot issues involving CPU, memory, storage, I/O, connections, waits, and database performance.**
* **Understand which DBA activities are handled by AWS and which activities remain the responsibility of the database/application team.**



****Production Support****



* **Investigate and resolve database\-related production incidents.**
* **Analyse blocking, deadlocks, long\-running queries, resource contention, and application/database performance issues.**
* **Perform root cause analysis and recommend permanent solutions.**
* **Support database deployments, schema changes, and release activities.**
* **Work closely with application developers and DevOps teams during production issues and releases.**



 If you're ready for your next challenge in database administration, apply now! 🚀

title: Lead - Data & AI Platform
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
 Hunch is a dating app built for follow\-through \- designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back\-and\-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
   

  

 With 2\.4M\+ daters, 1\.47M\+ dates planned, and 100% photo\-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe\-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post\-AI world.
   

  

 Link to our fundraising announcement
   

  

**Key Offerings Of Hunch**
* One Drop a Day: A small, hand\-picked set of photo\-verified profiles arrives daily \- chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place \- no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing \- just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time \- nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.


**About The Role**
 We're on the lookout for a SDE\-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose — and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own backend features end\-to\-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async \& event\-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM\-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual\-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node \+ Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice\-to\-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design \& delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands\-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End\-to\-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product\-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.


**Preferred Experience**
* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self\-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive pay along with an annual performance\-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).


**Life at Hunch**
 Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall \- getting two interested people into the same room.
   

  

**What We Hire For \- The ABCs**
 Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
   

  

* Authenticity \- Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness \- Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity \- The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.


**How We Work**
* Ownership, not theater \- You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real \- We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week \- show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out \- Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems \- You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.


**Backed by Global Investors**
 Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
   

  

**Experienced Leadership**
 Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) \- serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer\-tech startup.

description:

 Independent for over 70 years, Milliman delivers market\-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world’s most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation.  Milliman is undertaking a major business transformation program to replace and modernize our HRIS, Finance, Legal, and Professional Services Automation systems. As part of the Data Enablement Team, we are seeking a Data \& Application Integration Engineer to support the integrity, quality, and migration of data throughout this transformation. This role will work alongside senior engineers and business/technical teams, contributing to data mapping, migration, validation, and integration activities to enable a smooth transition to new enterprise platforms. This is a great opportunity for someone early\-to\-mid in their integration engineering career to grow their skills on a large\-scale enterprise transformation.

* Develop and maintain data workflows, and help automate recurring processes.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.

* Working proficiency with SQL and Python, and experience with relational databases.
* Foundational experience with data analysis, data profiling, data mapping, and ETL processes.
* Basic familiarity with CI/CD practices and tools.
* Good analytical skills with the ability to help translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, with willingness to collaborate across business and technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced project environment, with a comfort level asking questions, seeking guidance, and learning quickly as part of a larger transformation team.


**Preferred Qualifications**

 **Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems, database architecture, and microservices design patterns** 
 , along with strong experience in building high\-performance, secure, and event\-driven systems.

* **Java (8/11/17\+)**

* API\-first design
* Domain\-driven design (DDD)
* Event\-driven architecture
* Define service communication patterns:
* REST, gRPC
* Messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Implement resilience patterns:
* Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j/Hystrix)

* Bulkhead isolation



  





**2\. Database \& Data Architecture** 



* Design data strategies for microservices:
* Database per service pattern
* Saga pattern for distributed transactions

* **RDBMS:** 
 PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server

 MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis
* Implement:
* Data partitioning and sharding
* Replication and clustering
* High availability and disaster recovery
* Optimize performance:

* Caching strategies

**5\. Performance \& Scalability**

A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.

* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.

 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.

* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment
